name: Daiseki Co.,Ltd.
summary: Daiseki Co.,Ltd. engages in the industrial waste treatment and resource recycling activities in Japan. The company engages in research and restoration of polluted soil; recycling of waste plasterboard; washing and treatment of tanks; treatment of general waste; recycling of waste plastic; recycling of used automotive and industrial batteries; refining of lead; collection and recycling of used paper; and refining the lubricating oil, as well as selling the petrol products.
